new_learnings.text: Sector rotation from electronics→metals is decisive and institutional-grade. Our enriched candidate pool (cheesefortune_intersection) is 100% tech/electronics — zero metals/aviation candidates. When market leadership rotates to sectors we don't cover, the correct response is to hold cash, not force entries. 90.3% cash is the right allocation today.
new_learnings.mechanism: Institutional rotation creates sector-level momentum that overwhelms individual stock fundamentals. When capital flows OUT of your candidate sectors, no amount of stock-level analysis can overcome the sector gravity.

new_learnings.text: Intraday reversal from new high on 5-9× MAVOL30 volume is a reliable institutional distribution signal. Both 上海新阳 (5.22×, -6.17%) and 路维光电 (8.74×, -3.54%) showed the exact same pattern: open at record highs, close near lows on extreme volume. This is not retail noise — it's coordinated institutional rotation.
new_learnings.mechanism: When a stock opens at an all-time high and reverses to close near the low on volume 5×+ normal, institutions are using the liquidity of the opening spike to distribute positions. This pattern often precedes multi-day weakness.

new_learnings.text: The 3-day cold sector rule (from V2 framework) is being tested in real-time with 上海新阳. Its sector (电子化学品Ⅱ) went from #1 to #1 worst in a single session. The rule correctly keeps us in HOLD (day 1 only) rather than panic-selling, while setting a clear 6/16 deadline. This is the V2 discipline that V1 lacked.
new_learnings.mechanism: Single-day sector reversals can be noise. The 3-day rule prevents whipsaw exits while still enforcing sector discipline. This balances the need to cut losers with the risk of overreacting to one-day rotations.

new_learnings.text: 新宙邦 entry timing is questionable. The CATL 30万吨 deal was announced 6/7 — stock already ran before we entered today at ¥74.65 (dist_ma20=+7.1%). The catalyst is real but we may have paid up. The -3% first-3-days trigger at ¥72.41 is essential protection here.
new_learnings.mechanism: Even the strongest catalysts can be 'priced in' within 3-5 trading days of announcement. Entering after the initial spike means accepting higher stop-out risk. The -3% first-3-days rule exists precisely for this scenario.
